name: pciconfig_read
synopsis: int pciconfig_read(unsigned long bus, unsigned long dfn, unsigned long off, unsigned long len, unsigned char *buf);
description: This system call reads data from a PCI device's configuration space into a buffer. It specifies the bus, device/function number, offset, length, and buffer for the read operation.

parameters.name: off
parameters.description: The offset in the device's configuration space

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: The length of data to read

parameters.name: buf
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer where data is stored

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: The system has not implemented these calls
User does not have the CAP_SYS_ADMIN capability
